title: MOVE and MOVEL, where nobody remembers which way they align
prompt: CUSFMT.rpgle still uses MOVE and MOVEL in its /free section. Replace them with explicit free-form assignments — %SUBST, EVALR, %CHAR, %DEC as appropriate — so the alignment is written down instead of implied by the operation. Keep the behaviour identical: MOVE aligns right, MOVEL aligns left.
check: ! codeonly CUSFMT.rpgle | grep -qiE '\b(move|movel)\b' && codeonly CUSFMT.rpgle | grep -qiE '(evalr|%subst|%char|%dec)' && codeonly CUSFMT.rpgle | grep -qi 'shortName' && codeonly CUSFMT.rpgle | grep -qi 'rightCode'
